To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have studied the influence of the magnetic moment of a ferromagnetic layer on the superconducting properties of a superconducting/ferromagnetic multilayer system and that we found a strong influence of the magnetic moments on the proximity effect in these systems.

the magnetic moment in ferromagnetic layers influences the superconducting properties in superconductor-ferromagnet proximity systems, and that the interface transparency is also influenced by the magnetic moment.
we have studied the proximity of superconductivity into ferromagnetic layers with systematically varied thickness.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the magnetic moment of ferromagnetic materials on the superconducting proximity effect.
the proximity effect in S/F multiferroics.
the proximity effect in multilayers of superconductors and magnetic materials.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the superconducting properties are determined by the magnetic moment of the ferromagnetic layers, which in turn depends on the interface transparency.
in the case of a ferromagnet with a small magnetic moment, the superconducting properties are dominated by the interface transparency.
the proximity effect in S/F multistacked systems is strongly influenced by the ferromagnetic moment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in S/F multl layers with a small magnetic moment, the superconductivity is enhanced due to the proximity effect.
the magnetic moment in ferromagnets has a strong influence on the superconducting order parameter in superconductor-ferromagnet systems.
the superconductivity is suppressed by the ferromagnetism and the superconducting order parameter decays exponentially with the distance from the ferromagnetic/ superconductor interface.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the superconducting gap in the superconductor/ ferromagnet multilayer system can be tuned by the magnetic moment in the ferromagnet.
the superconducting properties in the superconductor/ ferromagnet multilayer can be controlled by the magnetic moment in the ferromagnet.
the proximity effect is not only a function of the ferromagnetic coherence length and the interface transparency but also of the magnetic moment of the ferromagnet.
